exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Expressions of reduction — by, down to

items.prompt: We reduced lead time ___ seven days, from 21 to 14.
items.hintAfterError: Para a QUANTIDADE da redução, use a preposição de 'diferença'.

items.prompt: Cycle time dropped from six hours ___ just four.
Harry shaved two days ___ the worst-case delivery time.
items.hintAfterError: Com 'shave' (cortar um pouco de algo), a partícula indica que a parte sai do total.

items.prompt: Variability was reduced ___ 60%, so it is now less than half of what it was.
The order-to-delivery window fell ___ five days, ___ twelve.
items.hintAfterError: Primeiro a quantidade da queda, depois o novo nível.
